interpretation: When a durable checkpoint is optional, the fused governed pipeline materially dominates both checkpoint candidates throughout the frozen matrix.
The result does not invalidate checkpoint ordering under a policy that requires a checkpoint, because fused is then governance-infeasible.
Within this q=0.20 through q=0.50 matrix, policy-first also materially dominates query-first.
Earlier frozen q=0.05 development evidence still shows query-first winners, locating a policy-conditioned crossover below q=0.20.
decision: Stop the optional-checkpoint three-candidate optimizer branch. Do not alter its frozen grid or gates. If optimizer work continues, treat fused selection as a governance-feasibility rule and characterize the separate policy-required checkpoint crossover without claiming this failed branch passed.
